Author: Mahesh Chandra Tripathi

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mahesh Chandra Tripathi,J.
Hon'ble Gajendra Kumar,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners; Shri G.P. Singh, learned A.G.A.-I for the State respondents and Shri Satyam Narayan, learned counsel for the informant.

2. The present writ petition has been preferred with the prayer to quash the impugned First Information Report dated 6.11.2023, registered as Case Crime No.324 of 2023 under Section 498A,
323, 504, 377, 353, 354ka, 354kha, 506, 376, 511 IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S. Jani, Distt.
Meerut and for a direction to the respondents not to arrest the petitioners in pursuance of impugned Monu And 8 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 11 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24957111/
1 First Information Report.

entities.text: Monu And 8 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 11 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. On the matter being taken up today, learned AGA-I, on the instructions, states that during investigation, Sections 376, 377 and 511 have been deleted.

4. Although the prayer for quashing of FIR has been made, but without insisting on the same, only submission is that all alleged offences are punishable with imprisonment upto seven years, therefore the police authorities are bound to follow the procedure laid down under Section 41-A Cr.P.C.
The petitioners have been wrongly implicated and could not be arrested.

Reliance has been placed on the judgement of Hon'ble the Apex Court in Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar, (2014) 8 SCC 273; Social Action Forum for Manav Adhikar Vs. Union of India, Ministry of Law and Justice and others in Writ Petition (Civil) No. 73 of 2015 with Criminal Appeal No. 1265 of 2017, Writ Petition (Criminal) No.
156 of 2017; Satendra Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and Another (2022) 10 SCC 51 and the judgment of co-ordinate Division Bench of this Court in Vimal Kumar & 3 others Vs.
State of U.P. & 3 others, 2021 (2) ACR 1147.
5.

entities.text: Arnesh Kumar Vs. State of Bihar, (2014) 8 SCC 273
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Social Action Forum for Manav Adhikar Vs. Union of India, Ministry of Law and Justice and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Satendra Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and Another (2022) 10 SCC 51
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text:
Vimal Kumar & 3 others Vs.
State of U.P. & 3 others, 2021 (2) ACR 1147
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
We have gone through the impugned first information report and without interfering in the same,
we are of the opinion that the guidelines framed by Hon'ble the Apex Court in the above noted judgements are equally applicable to the facts of the instant case.
6. Accordingly, the instant petition also stands disposed of in terms of the judgements as noted above.
